Hi, I’m Kishori Akola, a Master of Business Analytics student at Monash University.

I’m interested in how data can help us understand problems and make informed decisions. Through this blog, I explore research findings and communicate their significance using clear explanations and purposeful visualisations.

This website was created for ETC5523 Communicating with Data.
